title: Rate Memorandum — Term End Loading on Payment Plans
content:
The plan percentage of an Apartment Home Lease payment plan rises as the current Lease Term Agreement nears its end: a term ending no more than 120 days after the day of signing adds 0.10, one ending no more than 240 days after it adds 0.05, and one ending later adds nothing.

**Record read.** The term end date of the customer's Lease Term Agreement in current status for the lease, counted in calendar days from the day of signing. A lease with no current Lease Term Agreement on record is taken as having its term end 9999 days after the day of signing, and so adds nothing.

**Effect.** The loading is added to the plan percentage before the percentage is applied.

## Loading schedule

| Days from the day of signing to the current term's end date | Loading added |
|---|---|
| 120 or fewer | 0.10 |
| 121 to 240 | 0.05 |
| more than 240 | nothing |

## Boundaries (hypothetical signing on 1 March 2026)

| Current term ends | Days after signing | Loading |
|---|---|---|
| 29 June 2026 | 120 | 0.10 |
| 30 June 2026 | 121 | 0.05 |
| 27 October 2026 | 240 | 0.05 |
| 28 October 2026 | 241 | nothing |
